products.name: Xeros Series
products.description: High-capacity refrigerated air dryers engineered for tropical climates. 85 to 10,000 CFM. 3 to 16 bar g. Open and closed-loop. R407C eco-friendly refrigerant. India's widest range from a single manufacturer.

detail.tagline: Maximum efficiency. Minimum moisture. Built to power your operations.
detail.intro: The Xeros Series is a range of high-efficiency refrigerated air dryers engineered for reliable moisture removal from compressed air systems.
detail.cta_body: Our engineering team will design a Xeros system tailored to your air flow, pressure and environmental requirements.

products.name: Ecodrair Series
products.description: Compact tube-in-tube refrigerated dryers for space-constrained installations. 5 to 180 CFM. Energy-efficient with lowest operating cost in its class. Ideal for workshop, laboratory, and small-plant applications.

detail.intro: Every Ecodrair dryer is built to protect your production, cut your costs, and keep running — year after year.
detail.cta_heading: Need the Right Dryer for Your Application?
detail.cta_body: Tell us your requirements. Our experts will recommend the ideal Ecodrair model for you.

products.name: Adsorption Dryers
products.description: When refrigerated drying isn't enough. Dew points down to -70°C — essential for pharmaceutical, food-grade, and critical pneumatic applications. Heatless, heated-with-blower, and HOC configurations.

detail.tagline: Engineered Solution for Moisture-Free, High-Precision Operations
detail.intro: Adsorption dryers remove moisture using a pressure swing twin-tower process.
detail.cta_body: Our team can help you select the right dryer based on your application, dew point, and operating cost priorities.

products.name: Compressed Air Filters
products.description: Five-stage filtration from 25μm pre-filtration to 0.01μm final polishing. Achieve ISO 8573.1 Class 1 air quality — the highest international standard. Every filter pressure-tested before dispatch.

detail.tagline: High-efficiency filtration for particles, oil, and aerosols
detail.intro: SANPAR compressed air filters are designed to remove dust, liquid, oil aerosols, and vapors from compressed air systems.
detail.cta_body: Our experts will help you select the right filter grade, size, and configuration for your application.

products.name: Aftercooler
products.description: Remove up to 70% of moisture at the compressor outlet — before it enters your system. Air-cooled and water-cooled variants with copper tube construction and SS316 baffles. The first line of defence.

detail.tagline: High-performance after coolers engineered to reduce compressed air temperature, remove bulk moisture, and improve downstream system reliability — available in both air-cooled and water-cooled configurations for industrial applications.
detail.intro: Compressed air leaving the compressor carries heat and moisture that can affect dryers, pipelines, pneumatic equipment, and production reliability.
detail.cta_heading: Lower Temperature. Clean Air. Better Performance.
detail.cta_body: Choose the right after cooler solution for your system.

products.name: Moisture Separator
products.description: Centrifugal moisture separation with no moving parts — zero maintenance and virtually zero pressure drop (0.06 bar). Install it. Forget about it. It keeps working.

detail.tagline: High-efficiency removal of bulk water from compressed air
detail.intro: Centrifugal moisture separation with no moving parts — zero maintenance and virtually zero pressure drop (0.06 bar). Install it. Forget about it. It keeps working.
detail.cta_heading: Eliminate bulk moisture. Protect your equipment.
detail.cta_body: Choose the right moisture separator for your system.

products.name: Drains
products.description: Condensate drains that protect your system 24/7. Float, timer, mechanical, or electronic level-sensor types. Rated up to 16 bar g. The small component that prevents the biggest headaches.

detail.tagline: Efficient condensate removal without air loss
detail.intro: Condensate is an unavoidable byproduct of compressed air systems. If not removed effectively, it can lead to corrosion, equipment damage, and reduced efficiency.
detail.cta_heading: Keep your system clean. Keep your productivity high.
detail.cta_body: Choose the right drain for your application.
